steps.message: This project uses Maven, so the change belongs in pom.xml rather than any MSBuild binary-log workflow. Update the Maven compiler configuration from Java 17 to Java 21.

Set maven.compiler.release to 21 when the compiler plugin supports it, or update both maven.compiler.source and maven.compiler.target to 21. Do not use /bl or any MSBuild binlog option for this Maven configuration task.
